headline: Nasdaq Nears 2% Gains. The Tech Trade Is So Back.
summary: Deutsche Bank research strategists said this is part of the rotation into tech after hitting a bottom last week.  It marks a reversal of the rotation out of the sector seen in recent months.  "We see the rotation into Tech having further to go," they wrote, explaining, "This would be the 5th such rotation in the last 3 years with the market focus repeatedly swinging between stellar growth and bubbles fears at an increasing rate."

headline: Why Circle Internet Stock Is Slumping Today Even After a Fresh Buy Rating
summary: Wall Street is split on  Circle Internet Group  after two firms issued clashing calls on the stock, with one aggressive downgrade pulling the stock lower.  The biggest blow came from  Morgan Stanley  as analysts cut their rating on Circle shares to Underweight from Equal Weight with a $38 price target, down sharply from $106.  Circle stock tumbled 7% to $58.15 shortly after the market opened Monday.
